title: Uniform mass of a single disjoint-coordinate vector
statement: Let $n \ge 1$, and consider vectors of length $n$ whose entries are drawn from the three-element set $\{\text{neither}, \text{leftOnly}, \text{rightOnly}\}$ of disjoint-coordinate labels. Under the uniform law on these $3^n$ vectors, every individual vector $c$ carries probability mass \[ \frac{1}{3^n}. \]
hypotheses_covered: n is a positive natural number
c is a fixed vector of length n over the three disjoint-coordinate labels
replaced: Each generated disjoint coordinate vector has mass $3^{-n}$ under the uniform law.
